description: This file defines the EmployeeAllowedLanguageModel class, which models the allowed languages for an employee within the HRM system. It includes properties such as employee number and languages, and provides methods to serialize this data to an array, involving interactions with employee language services and data entities.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLanguageModel
classes.description: A model representing allowed languages for an employee, with methods to serialize data for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with employee number and language data.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguageService
methods.description: Lazily instantiates and returns the EmployeeLanguageService object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the model's data into an array, determining allowed fluency IDs for each language based on employee language records.
